annotations.title: Is this site in an Opportunity Zone or an NMTC-eligible tract?

description: Use when the user is structuring a real estate or business investment and asks about tax-advantaged capital for a specific site: "is this address in an Opportunity Zone?", "will it still be one in 2027?", "can this project use New Markets Tax Credits?". Geocodes each address with the Census Geocoder and checks its tract against the CDFI Fund’s lists: Opportunity Zones 1.0 (through 2028), Opportunity Zones 2.0 (from January 1, 2027) and NMTC low-income-community eligibility. An unmatched address is reported as unmatched, never as "not in a zone". Refuses before you are charged if the lists fail their integrity check or no address matches. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: current designations, plus OZ 2.0 from January 1, 2027; compare: addresses (up to 10); place: address. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For who lives around the site, use run_trade_area.
